bridgeAdapterPatches: Generation isolation for stale response detection
connectE2EE registers only devices without a server identity and waits for the encrypted socket
Credential login removed from the E2EE bridge; served by loginHelper

Page templates / XMA kept as structured template attachments with all CTAs + carousel items; legacy LSInsertAttachment rows converted; button templates (message text + CTA rows without a card) get a template with those buttons (bridge/xma.go orphanButtons, events.go)

fetchMessages RPC: per-thread history page via LightSpeed FetchMessagesTask, answered asynchronously; an existing-range answer must carry the request reference timestamp (as in mautrix-meta), one diagnostic log line per page (bridge/history.go)
E2EE: thumbs-up CommonSticker, image galleries, placeholders for view-once / payment / contact; signal-only payloads dropped instead of empty messages
Device store: WASA root secret accessors stay unsupported (same policy as MessageSecrets); only sending Meta bot/WASA messages is affected

Deplao thread features from mautrix-meta (bridge/deplao_threads.go): hybrid thread keys of encrypted chats remapped in handleTable and used for mute/delete/accept/read tasks (setHybridThreads RPC restores them), threadEncrypted (LSMoveThreadToE2EECutoverFolder / LSCreateOpenToE2EEThreadLink), threadInfo (LSSyncUpdateThreadName / LSSetThreadImageURL), viewerStatus (LSChangeViewerStatus), setUserBlock (SetUserBlockStatusTask), encrypted groups (events.GroupInfo, GetGroupInfo, UpdateGroupParticipants / LeaveGroup), disappearing timer read from FBApplication metadata and attached to sends (withChatTimer in messages.go / media.go)

Deplao incoming coverage from mautrix-meta (bridge/deplao_incoming.go): LSUpdateOrInsertThread rows, LSDeleteThenInsertMessageRequest status, contact block state (contactBlocks), undecryptable placeholders (replaced by the re-send), view-once media (ViewOnceMessage, Raven), bump as a reply, location_share XMA cards, story replies and XMA text (events.go DEPLAO_ADAPTER hooks), setAppState RPC (ReportAppStateTask)

Deplao diagnostics (bridge/deplao_diagnostics.go): e2eeDropped events for whatsmeow warnings / Unhandled debug lines (client.go wraps e2eeClient.Log before connect, 30 per minute), metadata-only messages and WhatsApp-format messages; timer events carry messageId, notice, fromMe, form, settingTimestamp, senderDevice and stale (late copies never turn a timer back)

loginHelper.reason: Separate module since fbchat-v2 2.3.2, whose pinned mautrix/meta crashed in the Bloks interpreter on Facebook's current Messenger Lite login pages (nil GetArg in bk.action.f32.Eq, missing bk.action.array.Get). The helper keeps its own vendored copy (login/meta via a replace directive) so the Bloks interpreter can be patched. Upstream v26.11 now implements bk.action.string.StartsWith itself; the patch only has to add bk.action.string.EndsWith/Contains, which the OTP input validation uses.

note: fbchat-v2 v2.3.5 (2026-11-20) still pins bridge-e2ee/meta cea2e38 (2026-08-25), libsignal v0.2.2 and whatsmeow 2026-09-19, so bumping the fbchat-v2 line alone changes nothing. Deplao vendors mautrix/meta forward to efc4c92 (v26.11, 185 commits) for the Messenger realtime fixes it needs: forced resync handling on the live socket (d779029, efc4c92), initial GraphQL mailbox sync fallback + 90s lightspeed sync timeout (472a7f0), libsignal v0.2.3 (Kyber/PQXDH message decoding, upstream 180b9ce), and current Chrome/Messenger user agents with the HelloChrome_Auto websocket TLS fingerprint. v26.11 requires whatsmeow 2026-11-16, libsignal v0.2.3, util v0.11.1 and mautrix v0.33.1-20261119; the four move together. See docs/plan-mautrix-meta-v26.11-upgrade.md.
